bestBets.overview: The regally bred ROYAL REFLECTION makes her debut for Peters Investments on the back of a very impressive trial win. W Pike rides and expecting her to take plenty of beating. GOD'S ENCHANTMENT looks the clear danger. He wasn't beaten far on debut and immediately turned out for a spell. He's been tuned up for his return with two strong trial efforts. AURA MAGNA has been solid in all three runs this time in. She rolls forward and gives a kick. MY MALENA is another on speeder with claims.

raceTips.comment:
Been waiting to see ROYAL REFLECTION at the races after an impressive trial opening. She was a long way off them and gathered the field up with ease. 1200m looks perfect and excited to see what they have here.
GODS ENCHANTMENT has a good run on the board last season at Ascot when running fourth behind some handy horses. Two trials leading into today has shown he hasn't gone backwards.
AURA MAGNA is having her fourth start and will be fit and likely rolling out in front while BIFF BAM BOOM will need to improve on his first outing.

bestBets.overview: BOUTIQUE BELLE should be primed for this at her third run back from a spell. She should appreciate the rise in trip and W Pike goes on for an apprentice. BACK IN THE FOLD was sound on debut after finding some traffic problems. He is another runner who looks suited with the rise in  trip. FLAVOURSOME has always showed some ability and has claims. MOMOTARO next best.

raceTips.comment:
She will start ridiculously short in this but BOUTIQUE BELLE does look to find a very suitable maiden dropping out of Saturday 3yo open Maiden company. I wouldn't be diving in at the $1.50 in particular if we dont yet know how the track is playing.
SOHO STORM was a huge improver last start and with only 53.5kg from B1 is probably the each way bet in the race.
BACK IN THE FOLD showed something closing in last start but was already well beaten on a heavy track.
MYSTACHEENO will have the fitness edge on a few of these third up.

bestBets.overview: HEAVENLY RAPTURE hasn't fired in either of her two starts this time in however they were in much better races than this. Expecting her to be ready to fire at her third run back from a spell and she should relish the big drop in grade. BARNEY ROMMEL attacks this off a four week let-up. He will park off the speed and should be finding the line well. AH KUM has run well in his last two starts. He settles close the speed and can give a kick. SECRETCHINO shook her maiden last with a tough on speed win.

raceTips.comment:
Thought SOLO VEGA looked a good bet here. Has returned in great form, ran well in a Class 3 two starts ago and didnt get a full run at them last start with those formlines standing up well. She raced in the staying 3yo season so we know the distance is no issues.
BARNEY ROMMEL gets the 3kg apprentice on and the Winkers. Think he will appreciate being back at Bunbury.
HEAVENLY RAPTURE will need a good ride by Holly to navigate some traffic but comes out of much stronger racing.
AH KUM and Sharon Miller call on Pike in the saddle.

bestBets.overview: PISTONE makes his debut on the back of two impressive trial wins. The blinkers go straight on and expecting him to park right over the speed and be hard to rundown. PLAYA DEL SOL parks on the speed and gives a sight. CHE FIGATA has ability and the blinkers go on. THE STALAGMITE has trialled well.

raceTips.comment:
PISTONE is beautifully placed at his first time at the races by the Pateman stable. Trialled very well and no suprise to see the early market support. Should go forward and be hard to run down.
VINO MISS finished just behind Hot Chix Lane first up and will be fitter for that experience. Barrier hurts though.
THE STALAGMITE was able to win his trial and draws kindly while PLAYA DEL SOL has had excuses at her first two starts this campaign.

bestBets.overview: OCEAN REEF is bursting to win a race after consistently finding the line strongly. From a good draw he can settle a little closer to the speed and run well. ZALI'S GIFT was sound first-up. She improves off that run and should appreciate the rise in trip. WIN FOR BUSTER will settle off the speed and find the line well. PLAYING SOLO can improve sharply on his first-up effort.

raceTips.comment:
Proper full field here so you will ned the right run in transit but ZALI'S GIFT returned in good order last start when hitting the line well at Belmont. This is easier, Lucy has a kinder barrier to work with and with any fitness improvement she should be hard to hold out.
OCEAN REEF has been putting in some nice maiden runs and handled the heavy track surface at Northam last start.
WIN FOR BUSTER was only 2 lengths off them at Belmont and SWEET ISSY maps for a soft run and was good two starts back.

bestBets.overview: SO IMMACULATE was sound first-up. She improves off that run and should get every chance from her inside draw. MODERN GIRL is shooting for a winning hat-trick. She will fire straight to the front and is the one to rundown. LASH OUT has ability and attacks this first-up with the benefit of two trials. HYPERREAL next best.

raceTips.comment:
LASH OUT was a good maiden winner over 1400m when wide throughout. Returns here of two trials and the booking of Pike is notable here for the Bayliss stable. 
MODERN GIRL could be the horse to beat - she has returned in excellent order for the Naylor camp. 1000 up to the 1200m is a small niggle for me.
HYPERREAL stuck on well in the heavy conditions of last start while GAV HAS SPOKEN has had two good runs back this campaign.

bestBets.overview: AIN'TSOBAD won well at this track two starts back before stepping up in grade and finishing midfield. From a good draw she parks on the speed and will be hard to rundown. TOO MUCH TALK is rock hard fit and racing well. DON'T TRUST JUDAS will appreciate the drop in grade. SUMMER'S LEGACY attacks this fresh with the benefit of two trials and should be doing her best work late.

raceTips.comment:
AINTSOBAD effectively won this exact same race four weeks ago and didnt disgrace herself in much tougher at Belmont. Like the placement and from B3 Brayden should give the 7yo mare every chance.
BUDERIM your likely on pace galloper and coming back to the 7 furlongs is a big tick in my books - B1 also assists.
TOO MUCH TALK was a good C3 winner last start and maps well while SUMMER'S LEGACY returns to the races with two trials under her belt. 1400m will be at the very bottom of her range.
